### The Key to Spiritual Maturity
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/solid-joys/the-key-to-spiritual-maturity
Passage: Hebrews 5:14
Points:
- Spiritual maturity and digesting solid biblical truth is primarily a moral challenge rather than merely an intellectual pursuit.
- The nourishing truth of the gospel must reshape our moral senses so we learn to distinguish good from evil.
- Unrepentant compromises in areas like money, entertainment, or integrity hinder our ability to understand deep biblical doctrine.
- Genuine growth in discernment comes through practical obedience rather than academic education or technical knowledge.

### Spiritually Aware
Author: Neil T. Anderson
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/dailyinchrist/daily-in-christ-8-25.html
Passage: Hebrews 5:14
Points:
- Spiritual discernment is identified in Scripture as a defining characteristic of a mature believer.
- Relying exclusively on human logic and analytical reasoning blinds believers to vital spiritual realities.
- Sound theology offers an indispensable foundation, but correct doctrine without the Holy Spirit becomes lifeless orthodoxy.
- Believers must train their spiritual senses by learning to recognize and test the Holy Spirit's guidance in daily life.
